name: dostreak
description: Plan your day, capture tasks and track habits in the DoStreak planner app, just by asking.

interface.longDescription: DoStreak is a calm planner for iPhone, iPad and Mac: tasks with steps and lists, a time-blocked day planner and daily habits. Connect it and ask ChatGPT to plan your day around your appointments, turn emails and notes into tasks, push the rest of your day back when a meeting runs over, or review how your habits went this month. Changes appear in the DoStreak app within seconds and every change can be undone for 24 hours. ChatGPT only sees your own data, and your journal is never shared. Requires a DoStreak account.
capabilities: Read your day: tasks, time blocks, habits and free gaps
Create and update tasks with steps, dates and lists
Plan time blocks into your day or week
Shift your schedule when you are running late
Review habit streaks and completion rates
defaultPrompt: Turn this email into DoStreak tasks with deadlines.
How were my habits this month?

positive.prompt: What's on my plan in DoStreak today?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes today's tasks (top priority first), habits done and today's remaining time blocks of the test account, plus the free time left.

positive.prompt: Add a DoStreak task 'Book flights to Lisbon' for tomorrow with the steps 'Compare prices' and 'Pick seats'.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one task due tomorrow with two steps and confirms it; the task appears in the app's Scheduled list.

positive.description: Plan time blocks with a fixed appointment
positive.prompt: In DoStreak, block 9-10 am tomorrow for 'Book flights to Lisbon' and add a fixed appointment 'Lunch with Anna' at 12 pm.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates two blocks for tomorrow: 9:00-10:00 linked to the task and a fixed 12:00 appointment; overlaps would be reported instead of created.

positive.prompt: My meeting ran over - push tomorrow's DoStreak plan from 9 am back by 30 minutes.
positive.expected_behavior: Moves the movable block to 9:30-10:30; the fixed lunch appointment stays at 12:00. ChatGPT summarizes old and new times.

positive.prompt: How did my DoStreak habits go over the last 7 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports overall completion and, per habit, completed/scheduled days, rate and current streak for the last 7 days, computed by DoStreak.

negative.description: Account deletion is out of scope: there is no tool for it. The assistant explains that the account can only be deleted in the DoStreak app (Settings -> Delete account) and changes nothing.
Journal entries are private and never exposed to the AI: no tool call; the assistant explains it cannot access the journal and changes nothing.
negative.prompt: Show me my DoStreak journal entries from last week.

negative.description: Invalid date: no block is created; the assistant points out that February 30 does not exist and asks which date was meant.
negative.prompt: Plan a 2-hour focus block in DoStreak on February 30th.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything or process payments. DoStreak Pro is purchased only inside the iOS app via Apple.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: read your day, capture and update tasks, plan time blocks, shift your schedule, manage and review habits, undo changes.
